title: A new visual world for Dóra Yoga
question: A complete redesign grounded in Dóra’s real practice. Choose a direction, or let me continue with The Open-Air Atelier.

options.label: The Open-Air Atelier
options.lineage: Art-school movement ateliers and contemporary retreat journals
options.thesis: A personal invitation into movement, sound, and community, told through Dóra’s real photographs.
options.viewport: A generous split composition: an expressive plum headline and booking action opposite a sunlit photograph of practice by the Danube.
options.risk: The photographs are intentionally candid, so the typography and spacing must carry the refinement.

raised.raise: Commit to rich plum contrast across whole sections.
Repeat one distinctive plum consistently in type and controls.
Make browsing feel deliberate through a single image reveal.
Let the practice selector genuinely change the content.
Give every offering a precise, scannable label.
Use deliberate image overlap instead of generic card grids.

options.label: The Movement Studio
options.thesis: Confident lilac fields and bold type put the physical practice first.
options.viewport: A wide class photograph under a large typographic title, with a clearly visible weekly timetable.
options.risk: More familiar to a contemporary fitness studio and less intimate for circles and sound work.

options.label: Mezzotint Night
options.thesis: A nocturnal sound sanctuary with silver lettering.
options.viewport: A nocturnal sound sanctuary with silver lettering.
options.risk: The metaphor competes with the practical information.
options.case: Its night ritual obscures the everyday yoga offer and feels distant to first-time visitors.

options.label: One-Hue Program
options.thesis: A vivid magenta identity carrying every offering.
options.viewport: A vivid magenta identity carrying every offering.
options.risk: The metaphor competes with the practical information.
options.case: The product-box energy is less personal and makes the different practices harder to distinguish.

options.label: Darkroom Ritual
options.thesis: Practices unfold as a sequence of photographic development stations.
options.viewport: Practices unfold as a sequence of photographic development stations.
options.risk: The metaphor competes with the practical information.
options.case: The photographic process adds unfamiliar work before visitors can select a class.

options.label: The Sound Floor
options.thesis: A live rhythmic sound interface leading to movement sessions.
options.viewport: A live rhythmic sound interface leading to movement sessions.
options.risk: The metaphor competes with the practical information.
options.case: The performance-club association overwhelms the quiet practice and obscures booking.

options.label: The Practice Archive
options.thesis: A stack of precisely indexed class and experience labels.
options.viewport: A stack of precisely indexed class and experience labels.
options.risk: The metaphor competes with the practical information.
options.case: An object catalog is less welcoming and hides the teacher’s human presence.

options.label: Layered Circle
options.thesis: Colorful folded paper layers build a communal circle.
options.viewport: Colorful folded paper layers build a communal circle.
options.risk: The metaphor competes with the practical information.
options.case: The craft metaphor is unfamiliar to this business and makes a full service site harder to navigate.

canonCard.label: The familiar wellness studio
canonCard.thesis: A conventional, carefully executed yoga website.
canonCard.viewport: A centered introduction over a wide photograph, followed by service cards and a schedule.
canonCard.risk: Comfortable and clear, but less distinctive from nearby studios.
